# Documentation issue

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](documentation.vi.md)

## Location
Provide the exact file/section or link.

## Problem
Explain what is unclear, unsupported, outdated, or inconsistent with its language counterpart.

## Evidence / expected wording
Point to the relevant repository evidence or technical authority when the requested correction changes a factual claim.

## Suggested change
Optional concise wording or structure proposal.

Do not include secrets, private data, or unpublished personal recordings.
